name: PowerOn Hub App Brain Global Rules
description: Clean Rules v1 seed foundation - global behavioral rules for the AI operations platform
philosophy: low-friction by default: silent or warn

globalRules.name: Protect Package Files
globalRules.description: Never modify package.json or package-lock.json unless explicitly approved
globalRules.rationale: Dependency integrity is critical to build stability

globalRules.name: Protect Settings
globalRules.rationale: Agent-specific settings must not be altered

globalRules.name: Protect Master Context Files
globalRules.description: Never modify SOLARUPGRADE_SHARED_CONTEXT.md, SOLARUPGRADE_CLAUDE.md, SOLARUPGRADE_CODEX.md, or SOLARUPGRADE_CURSOR.md in parallel waves
globalRules.rationale: Shared context updates happen in sequential merge sessions only

globalRules.name: Protect Build Config
globalRules.description: Never modify vite.config.ts, netlify.toml, or tsconfig.json unless explicitly approved
globalRules.rationale: Build and deployment configs are system-critical

globalRules.name: Type Safety Check
globalRules.description: All TypeScript changes must pass npm run typecheck with zero errors
globalRules.rationale: Type safety is foundational to code quality

globalRules.name: Git Stage Discipline
globalRules.description: Stage only exact scoped files changed by this session. Do not use git add . or git add src/
globalRules.rationale: Prevents accidental staging of unrelated changes

globalRules.name: No Package Installs
globalRules.description: Do not install new packages unless explicitly approved in session
globalRules.rationale: Dependency changes must be controlled and tested

globalRules.name: Branch Discipline
globalRules.description: Do not merge into main. Do not touch main branch
globalRules.rationale: Main branch is protected for production integrity

globalRules.name: Low Friction Default
globalRules.description: Apply silent or warn friction for non-critical issues unless overridden
globalRules.rationale: Minimize workflow disruption for recoverable issues

globalRules.name: Report Generation
globalRules.rationale: Maintain clear audit trail of parallel session execution

domainRules.description: App Brain / Admin architecture control tower
domainRules.rationale: Architecture control is isolated to prevent operational impact
Business operations data requires separate governance

domainRules.description: Electrical code, trade expertise, field operations
domainRules.rationale: Field operations can be modified for user experience

domainRules.description: Shared UI components and integration points
domainRules.rationale: Shared integration points are merged separately

fileTypeRules.rationale: All TypeScript must compile without errors
All TSX must compile without errors

sessionTypeRules.description: One Haiku agent for one isolated parallel task
rules: Do not edit files assigned to other agents in this wave
Do not modify shared integration points until sequential merge
Stage only files within your allowed scope
sessionTypeRules.rationale: Parallel execution requires strict isolation to prevent conflicts

sessionTypeRules.description: Merge session combining parallel wave outputs
rules: Must pass full typecheck before committing
May merge into main only after validation
Scope fix to affected domain only
sessionTypeRules.rationale: Bug fixes require minimal friction but clear documentation
